## FilesystemError.path property

The path that caused the error. In practice the Rust core always supplies this for `VaultError::Filesystem`<!-- -->, so `undefined` only occurs if a malformed boundary shape omitted it — never fabricated as an empty string, so its absence is distinguishable from a genuine path.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly path?: string;
```
